title: Add missing data chunk and non-PCM WAV error tests
description: Add two parseWavHeader tests: WAV file without a data chunk must throw, and WAV with non-PCM audio format must throw CorruptedAudioError.
acceptanceCriteria: parseWavHeader throws when RIFF/WAVE has fmt chunk but no data chunk
parseWavHeader throws for non-PCM audio format values (e.g. format=3 WAV)
parseWavHeader throws for non-PCM format with different values (e.g. format=6)
notes: Both missing tests target src/lib/storage/audio-metadata.test.ts. Helper buildWavFile already supports changing audioFormat via raw buffer manipulation.
